catalog.summary: Read and unread notifications with actions.

reference: UI5 ui5-notification-list, Novu Inbox, Knock NotificationFeed, MagicBell Inbox, GitHub notifications inbox
engine: @slotted/core/timeline — feedFocusTarget for the Feed keyboard, formatTimestamp and setSizeOf for the items
rootRole: region, named by the title message or the consumer's aria-label

roles.views: tablist, held by tabs; the feed is its one panel
roles.group: none; the group-label is a heading one rank below the title

anatomy.root: a section: the region, the container query and the element a ref returns
anatomy.header: the row above the views: title, mark-all, the consumer's actions
anatomy.title: on the header, the heading at level with the unread count as a badge after the words; on an item, the words that name it — a link when href, text otherwise, clamped at two lines
anatomy.mark-all: a button that asks to mark every unread item read; disabled while nothing is unread
anatomy.actions: on the header, the consumer's own controls — a preferences link, a menu; on an item, the consumer's controls for that item under its body
anatomy.views: the tabs family's list over views; absent when views holds one entry
anatomy.fresh: the held arrivals: a button naming their count; present while held > 0
anatomy.feed: the list, role=feed, aria-busy while loading, aria-labelledby the title
anatomy.group: when groupBy: the items of one group under a group-label
anatomy.group-label: the heading of a group, one rank below the title
anatomy.item: an article, tabindex=0, aria-labelledby its title, aria-describedby its description, aria-posinset and aria-setsize
anatomy.visual: the consumer's avatar or icon at the small step; for an item with a tone and no visual, the family's own — the tone's glyph filled: the tone's surface as a disc under the ringed glyph at the ring's own radius, the two on one box so they are concentric, the avatar's diameter, the same read or not; absent when the item has neither, and the words take the column
anatomy.content: title, description, time, actions, in that order
anatomy.description: the body of the notification, clamped at three lines
anatomy.time: a time element with datetime, written relative or absolute
anatomy.controls: the family's two controls at the inline end, muted at rest and in the text ink on the row under the pointer or holding focus; each opens a tooltip with its name on hover, keyboard focus and a held touch, and grows to the comfortable target under a coarse pointer; which of the two exist is the controls axis
anatomy.read-toggle: an icon button: the check glyph while unread (mark read), the dot glyph while read (mark unread); named by the markRead and markUnread messages
anatomy.dismiss: an icon button with the x glyph that asks to remove the item; named by the dismiss message
anatomy.more: under growing=button a button asking for the next page; under growing=scroll the sentinel an IntersectionObserver watches; absent under none
anatomy.empty: in place of the feed when it holds nothing: the consumer's result-state, or the empty message (caughtUp under the unread view)
anatomy.footer: the consumer's link from the popover to the page; absent when not written
anatomy.count: a chip beside words, in tabular figures on the sunken surface: the unread total after the header's title, in the accent pair; a view's count in its tab

wiring.aria-labelledby: on the root and the feed, naming the title; on an item, naming its title
wiring.aria-describedby: on an item with a description, naming it
wiring.aria-busy: true on the feed while loading
wiring.aria-posinset / aria-setsize: on each article: its position, and count when the consumer states it, the loaded number under growing=none, -1 while more may come
wiring.aria-controls: on each tab of the views strip, naming the feed
wiring.aria-live: a polite announcement, once per change, of the held arrivals' count and of the unread count

onOpen.from: the title link, before its navigation; cancellable

onUnreadChange.from: a fact reported when the unread count changes, for the bell

arrivals.hold: new keys that arrive while document.activeElement is inside the feed or the feed's scroll container is scrolled past its start are held behind fresh; otherwise they show at once
arrivals.reveal: shows the held keys in the consumer's order and, on a keyboard press, moves focus to the first revealed article
arrivals.immediate: a change to a shown item and a removal apply at once under both values
arrivals.announce: polite, once per change of the held count

views.unread: the family shows the items whose read is false
views.other: the items are what the consumer gave for that view
views.initial: all when neither view nor defaultView is stated

time.value: PlainDateTime or an ISO instant, as @slotted/core/timeline reads it
time.format: formatTimestamp with locale (the language in force unless stated), timeZone, now and timeFormat
time.reason: one formatter for two families that write a when

clamp.reason: the whole text stays in the DOM; a notification longer than that opens the thing it is about. UI5's show-more link is declined

keyboard.effect: moves through the header's controls, the views strip's selected tab, fresh, then each article and the controls inside it, then more and the footer
on an article: moves to the next article
on an article: moves to the previous article; on the first, to fresh when it is present
on an article: moves to the first focusable element after the feed
on an article: moves to the first focusable element before the feed
on an article: asks to remove it with the reason keyboard; accepted, focus moves to the next article, or the previous, or the feed's start
on the title link: asks onOpen with the reason keyboard before the navigation; on any button: presses it
on the views strip: moves between views and asks onViewChange with the reason keyboard

showMore.reason: UI5's wrappingType with a Show more link; the clamp keeps the whole text in the DOM and the item opens the thing

preferences.reason: a product's settings screen; the header's actions slot holds the link

snooze.reason: a product policy over the store; the item's actions slot holds the control

bulkSelection.reason: a selection over the feed composed over the same items

virtualization.reason: the answer timeline gave for the same list

collapsibleGroups.reason: only UI5 folds a group, and a folded group hides what the reader came for

rail.reason: a notification is a row with a dot, not an event on a rail; timeline's engine is reused and its paint is not

bell.reason: the notifications control with its count is drawn there; the family reports the count

open.reason: the floating host owns open, placement and dismissal

badge.reason: a count beside a title is a figure, not a status; badge's smallest step read as a status beside the words, so the count is the family's own chip on the type scale's smallest step, as top-navigation draws the bell's count

resolution: the consumer's explicit prop, then the family's defaults provider, then the fallback

unreadMark.signals: a wash mixed from the tone's text at the highlight share, and the semibold title
unreadMark.reason: no mark: a dot in a column of its own read as a bullet, a disc on the title's line sat off the avatar's axis, a dot on a visual that already carries the tone said the tone twice, and a solid visual shouted beside the avatars; the wash and the weight are read without colour, and the read-toggle says the rest

toneGlyph.reason: the family's own visual for an item with a tone and no visual; every glyph is a circle — a triangle is refused in this library for its asymmetry, and the alert family's warning glyph is a debt it owns
